thrust_to_weight.source: user requirement 2026-10-17 (hover thrust at full throttle over MTOW)

safety_factor.source: stand-in: the usual factor for ultimate load on a composite part

lap_length_m.source: same flight, 10 endurance laps in place of 1

lap_count.source: same flight, 10 endurance laps in place of 1

deployment_hover_s.source: Mk4 sheet for the deployment hover

reserve_hover_s.source: user requirement 2026-10-17 (5 min reserve hover battery)

base.source: wing, htail, fin and tail boom come from aircraft/currawong

static_margin_target.source: user decision 2026-10-17: CG = NP - SM x MAC; 10 % MAC is the design choice

cg_nose_prop_m.source: user measurement 2026-10-17: CG about 0.800 m behind the nose propeller hub (estimate; the CG is a design output)

width_m.source: stand-in: the Currawong V1 maximum width (aircraft/currawong fuselage frames); size the bay for the real battery

height_m.source: stand-in: the Currawong V1 maximum height

nose_behind_hub_m.source: Currawong V1 is 0.07 m behind the nose propeller hub at the nose

x_tail_m.source: user 2026-10-21: the pod tail end stays 561 mm aft of the wing root leading edge (the start of the old tail boom). The new tail boom starts inside the pod, so the pod end no longer follows the boom

bay_x_m.source: stand-in: the battery centre can sit between these x (Currawong bay)

battery_Wh_per_L.source: stand-in: LiPo pack energy density for the bay check

E_Pa.source: user 2026-10-21: the bought lift boom tube, E = 80 GPa. E_c keeps the ratio E_c / E of the roll-wrapped data

density_kg_m3.source: page gives 0.055 with no unit; read as lb/in3 (not confirmed)

G_Pa.source: stand-in: typical 2x2 twill tube shear modulus; no maker figure found

buckling_knockdown.source: stand-in. NASA SP-8007 gives gamma = 1 - 0.901 (1 - exp(-phi)), phi = sqrt(R/t) / 29.8 (axial) and 0.731 in place of 0.901 for bending; the formula is from a search snippet, check it before use

r_o.source: user 2026-10-21: the lift boom tube is the tail boom tube, 25.4 mm outer diameter (outer radius 12.7 mm)

t.source: user 2026-10-21: the lift boom tube is the tail boom tube, 23.4 mm inner diameter (wall 1.0 mm)

dx.source: boom clamp shift from the wing root mid-chord (stand-in until the spar x is in the tree)

overhang_m.source: stand-in: boom length beyond each hub

mount_offset_m.source: stand-in: thrust line offset from the boom axis (torsion arm)

clamp_kg.source: stand-in: clamp at the wing, measure the part

r_over_t_max.source: stand-in: limit of the thin-wall tube formulas

tip_slope_max_deg.source: stand-in: boom tip slope at T_max

resonance_margin.source: stand-in: f1 stays outside 1P hover +/- 20 %. The principle (no coincidence of airframe and rotor frequency) is ISO 5109:2023. The margin is not from that text (not read)

resonance_side.source: user decision 2026-10-21: the boom must not be resonant at or near the hover rpm. below: f1 under the band, so hover to full throttle is above the mode. Burela and Sujit 2026 (arXiv 2607.22768, V.C) use the stricter f1 >= 1.5 x blade passing at peak rpm

design.source: Proptimiser design, Jung 2021 T-motor shape fitted to the MAD FLUXER 22x6.6 maker table (Redback)

design_aircraft.source: work folder that holds the design file and the state file

reference_radius_m.source: R_tip of the design file (D 559 mm). The scale s = R / 0.2794 gives other radii

scale.source: R / reference radius. Bounds: 406 mm to 660 mm diameter (16 in to 26 in). User decision 2026-10-17: 762 mm gained only 5.5 % energy for a 36 % extrapolation of the FLUXER blade

cant.source: tilt of each rotor about its radial axis; range 0 to 10 deg

blade_diameter_m.source: MAD FLUXER 22x6.6: 22 in, converted to SI

blade_pitch_m.source: MAD FLUXER 22x6.6: 6.6 in, converted to SI. P/D is the pitch of an order sheet when the parts list gives none

prop_g_a_in2.source: AIAA 2016-0581 Eq. 5, carbon (m = p1 (2R)^2 + p2 (2R) + p3; the text gives no p3, so p3 = 0; 2R in inch, from the figure axis)

tip_clearance_m.source: stand-in: gap between prop discs and the nearest structure

tip_mach_max.source: stand-in: tip Mach limit of the NeuralFoil sections

coaxial_spacing_over_D.source: Brazinskas et al. 2016: the 22 % loss holds for z/D > 0.25, so the pair is spaced at 0.25 D

table_omega_rad_s.source: numeric BEMT samples over the shaft speed range of the Opti variable

table_scale.source: geometric scale samples, inside the radius bounds

table_v_x_m_s.source: hover and the 2.5 m/s vertical climb of the mission

table_poly_degree.source: stand-in: lowest degree with a fit error under 1 % of CT; see the printed RMS

momentum_omega_rad_s.source: hover shaft speed of the base blade at about 37 N thrust (15 kg on 4 rotors); sets FM and the hover CT

design_aircraft.source: work folder that holds the design file and the state file

table_omega_rad_s.source: shaft speed range of the Opti variable of the cruise propeller

table_fit_J_max.source: the Currawong V1 blade gives CT below zero for J above 0.6; the fit covers the thrust range only

table_poly_degree.source: stand-in: lowest degree with a fit error under 1 % of CT

q_cap.source: torque the motor holds for the 180 s peak current, (Imax - I0)/Kv of the survey

kv_min.source: rows of the survey used by the fit

kv_max.source: rows of the survey used by the fit

mass_min_g.source: rows of the survey used by the fit

mass_max_g.source: rows of the survey used by the fit

mount_kg.source: stand-in: Redback motor mount mass, check against aircraft/redback

survey.source: maker ESC rows, Hobbywing XRotor Pro H series and T-Motor ALPHA (tools/aerosandbox/data); the fit uses the rows rated for the pack cell count

peak_factor.source: stand-in: ESC rated at 1.2 times the peak motor current

re_ohm.source: stand-in: ESC resistance, inside the 9 to 45 mOhm range of AIAA 2016-0581 section II.B

duty_max.source: stand-in: ESC duty limit with a margin for the control

x_m.source: x of the pack centre; between the bay limits (stand-in: Currawong bay)

cell_nominal_V.source: LiPo, Gens ace listing: 22.2 V for 6S

ocv.source: stand-in: Aerolink OCV table of the Galeotti 2023 LiPo cells at 25 C (data/ocv_lipo_SOURCE.md), not the pack cell

cell_resistance_mohm.source: stand-in: makers say 'low IR' only. aerolink flight battery fits R_b from a flight log

c_rate_max.source: Gens ace / Tattu 4500 mAh 25C pack, maximum continuous

usable_fraction.source: stand-in: share of the charge the mission may use (the lowest SOC is 1 - this)

eq4_p1.source: AIAA 2016-0581 Eq. 4: m = (p1 s + p2) C, g, C in mAh

cal_cells_s.source: calibration pack: Gens ace / Tattu 4500 mAh 22.2 V 25C 6S1P

cal_mass_kg.source: Propalyser component for the NXE 6S 4500 pack (631 g, 99.9 Wh). The Gens ace listing says 610 g

current_density_A_m2.source: stand-in: 10 A/mm2 for short silicone leads in free air; ampacity table not found

insulation_factor.source: stand-in: mass of insulation as a fraction on the copper mass

run_extra_m.source: stand-in: extra lead length for routing at each end of the run

projects_mass_kg.source: user 2026-10-21: avionics projects (project equipment). Stand-in value. The flight avionics is the Currawong AVIONICS-REST mass (0.609 kg, weighed)

power_W.source: stand-in: flight avionics, avionics projects and servos

mass_kg.source: stand-in: VTOL skids; the Currawong gear is 1.32 kg
user 2026-10-21: payload 410 g, released at the deployment (aircraft/redback 1.2.17 cargo)

boom_cf.source: stand-in: skin friction of a smooth tube at Re about 1e6 (flat plate, turbulent)

boom_form_factor.source: stand-in: Hoerner form factor of a cylinder along the flow

nacelle_cda_m2.source: stand-in: drag area of one motor and mount in the flow

stopped_prop_cda_per_r2.source: stand-in: drag area of a stopped prop aligned with the flow, per m2 of R squared

cl_max_usable_factor.source: stand-in: factor on the AeroBuildup CL at 12 deg

map_turn_radius_m.source: stand-in: 30 deg bank turns at 15 m/s

bandwidth_rad_s.source: ADS-33E-PRF, 'all other MTEs and divided attention', Level 1 (Ivler et al., Toward a UAS Handling Qualities Specification, Methodology)

bandwidth_length_m.source: derived: 1.8 ft x 21.7 = 39 ft (Ivler et al., Table 2 and Eq. 1)

amplitude_rad.source: stand-in: 10 deg, the heading tolerance of the Ivler MTE tables. Not a figure for roll or pitch

margin.source: stand-in: factor on the required angular acceleration

yaw_rad_s2.source: user decision 2026-10-17 after a sweep of 0.5 to 3.0 (cost 2 Wh above 1.0, cant 5.6 deg). No yaw figure in Ivler et al.

idle_thrust_fraction.source: stand-in: lowest rotor thrust in flight as a fraction of the hover thrust

k_int.source: derived: 1 / (1 - 0.22), the power factor at equal thrust (Brazinskas et al. 2016, abstract: 22 % loss for torque-balanced coaxial at z/D > 0.25). Leishman and Syal case 4b gives 1.26

result.pitch_note: no pitch given: P/D of the base blade (MAD_FLUXER_22x6_6_jung), scaled
